Best Pitcher Honor Goes to Peralta of New York
The National League made the official announcement today. The 2026 National League Cy Young Award has gone to <Freddy Peralta:player#38620> of <New York:team#19>.

He had a superlative season, chalking up a 17-6 won-lost mark with an impressive 2.79 ERA.

<Peralta:player#38620> logged 34 starts, threw 193.1 innings, yielded 126 hits, struck out 192 and held the opposition to a .184 batting average.

He received 22 first place votes out of a possible 32. <Cristopher Sanchez:player#39043> of the <Philadelphia Phillies:team#21> finished second in voting with 5 first place votes, while <Paul Skenes:player#48634> of the <Pittsburgh Pirates:team#22> finished third with 1 first place vote.
